t: You're on the south side of Trafalgar Square, looking at the Trafalgar St. James, a contemporary boutique hotel in the heart of Westminster. It's part of Hilton's Curio Collection, so the name above the door traces back to Conrad Hilton, the American hotelier who founded the Hilton chain. He bought his first hotel in Texas in 1919 and eventually built the world's first international hotel chain. Here, that big brand sits behind a smaller, more individual hotel, right beside one of London's best-known squares.
